items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had made a record with Chu and Roy.

ctx.x: Foots Thomas played sax with Jelly Roll, right?

Tenor sax. Yeah. Foots Thomas nice people, person, and a hell of arranger, and a nice gentleman. He . . . no conniver. Never put nobody down. Just great. So they wanted, Cab wanted to get a guitar player. I had made a record with Chu and Roy.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: We were on the stand, Danny Barker, Chu Berry, the band... And the Cotton Club show is going on.

ctx.x: Do you remember some of the guys in his band? You know, Tyree...

Tyree, Chu Berry, Greeley Walton, Walter Thomas, Lamar Wright... Lamar's got two sons who played trumpet; they must have had the children playing trumpets. And there was Jerry Blake, a fantastic musician, swings,
